prompt:
Single soft organic teal blob shape for Filipino education app KursoKo hero section. Exactly ONE blob in frame — smaller secondary accent blob.

STYLE: 2D flat edu illustration — soft fluffy cloud-like amoeba, CreativeHive decorative blob. Single teal hue: base #4DB6AC with optional soft #26A69A depth at core. NOT 3D sphere, NOT photoreal cloud, NOT hard geometric shape. Smaller and more compact than a primary lavender blob.

EDGE: soft feathery transparent fade at perimeter — no hard ink outline, no square crop edge. Organic dissolve into alpha.

SHAPE: one amoeba-like blob, off-center mass OK, no face, no character, no stars, no lavender.

BACKGROUND: transparent PNG, no white canvas, no drop shadow.

OUTPUT: 240×240 square, ~20px safe padding, soft edges only.
